story_info.title: Oliver Fox and the Wobbly Tower
story_info.subtitle: Learning to Say Sorry
story_info.moral: Saying sorry and helping makes friendships strong.

main_character.name: Oliver Fox
main_character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

supporting_characters.name: Barnaby Badger
supporting_characters.appearance: A small, stout badger with black and white stripes on his face, small round ears, and short grey fur.
supporting_characters.role: Oliver's friend whose block tower gets knocked over.

cover.visual_action: Oliver Fox and Barnaby Badger happily building a block tower together

slides.title: Oliver Sees a Tower
slides.text: Oliver Fox loved Blossom Meadow. The sun felt warm on his fur. He saw Barnaby Badger building. Barnaby stacked many colourful blocks. He was making a very tall tower. "Hello, Barnaby!" Oliver called out. He wagged his fluffy tail. Oliver ran to see the tower. Barnaby smiled at his friend. "Look how tall it is!" Barnaby said. Oliver thought it was amazing.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Oliver and Barnaby in Blossom Meadow, setting a happy scene.

slides.title: Oops, It Fell Down!
slides.text: Oliver wanted to help. He quickly put a block on top. But Oliver was too fast. The big tower began to wobble. "Oh no!" cried Barnaby. Crash! All the blocks fell down. They scattered all around. Barnaby felt very sad. He had worked so hard.
slides.speaker_notes: Show the small conflict: Oliver's accidental mistake and Barnaby's sadness.

slides.title: Oliver Says Sorry
slides.text: Oliver's playful grin faded. He saw Barnaby's sad face. "I am so sorry, Barnaby," Oliver said softly. Barnaby did not look up. His eyes were watering. He just looked at the fallen blocks. Oliver knew he made a mistake. He thought, "Let's solve it together!"
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver reflects on his mistake and uses his catchphrase to find a solution.

slides.title: Building Together
slides.text: "Let's build it again!" Oliver said. "Even better!" Barnaby slowly looked up. Oliver picked up a big red block. "We can build it super strong," Oliver cheered. Barnaby picked up a blue block. Together, they started to stack. They laughed as they built.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver and Barnaby start working together, showing a step towards resolution.

slides.title: Friends Again!
slides.text: Soon, a new tower stood tall. It was bigger and much stronger! Barnaby clapped his paws. "Thank you, Oliver!" he said. Oliver felt warm inside. Making friends happy felt wonderful. Saying sorry and helping makes friendships strong. They played happily all afternoon.
slides.speaker_notes: The happy resolution, emphasizing the lesson of forgiveness and strong friendships.
